fixture.name: aclocal-full-engine
fixture.input_sha256: 10 test functions including --install, serial tracking, dry-run

comparison.filesystem_outputs: class_location_match (aclocal.m4 generated with correct header and .m4 file inclusion; --install copies third-party .m4 files with serial number tracking)

positive_claim: AM.CLI.ACLOCAL.1 sealed: Native aclocal engine scans configure.ac for AC_CONFIG_MACRO_DIRS, AC_CONFIG_MACRO_DIR, and m4_include directives. Discovers .m4 files from system directories (/usr/share/aclocal-1.18, /usr/share/aclocal). Generates aclocal.m4 with proper header and all .m4 file inclusions. --install copies third-party .m4 files to first -I directory with serial number comparison (newer serial triggers update). --dry-run prevents actual file copies. --force always regenerates output. --diff runs diff comparison. -I DIR and ACLOCAL_PATH honored. Serial numbers extracted from '# serial N' comments. 10 tests: extract_single_arg, extract_bracket_args, extract_serial, serial_is_newer, scan_basic, generate, install_missing_files_dry_run, install_missing_files_actual_copy.
non_claims: aclocal-rs output may differ from GNU aclocal in file ordering and header format (NC.ADMIT.3)
Serial number extraction limited to '# serial N' format — GNU aclocal also supports m4_serial format
m4_include resolution relative to search dirs only — no recursion into included files' own dependencies

known_divergences.oracle_behavior: GNU aclocal inserts '# generated automatically by aclocal 1.18.1'
known_divergences.rust_behavior: Inserts '# generated automatically by aclocal-rs 0.1.0 (clean-room forensic-parity reconstruction)'
